idea: IDEA 2 tail-risk detector: predict pre-submission which conversation answers land <0.50 or <=cohort-0.05, from inference-time features only

honest_n_check.floor: positives < 8 in the primary healthy cohort -> analysis demoted to DESCRIPTIVE per pre-registered rule; no classifier/LOO claims made

descriptive_separation.ranked_cohort_n6_y_low_pos2: NO separation: the 2 healthy positives have hist_mean_cos 0.622/0.655, ABOVE the 0.582/0.610 of two negatives - direction inverted vs the unknown cohort; recall 0 at any FPR<0.5 threshold

confound_that_kills_it.claim: the apparent unknown-cohort signal is largely re-detection of truncated/pool historical answers, which the pipeline already knows at inference time as res.source
evidence: corr(hist_mean_cos, hist_poolonly_frac) = -0.707 over the 41 scored unknown rows
the deepest positive (cos 0.304, live 0.295) has 75% pool-only tags; both known hist_source=pool rows sit at cos 0.364/0.254 with poolonly_frac 1.0
y_low positives mean poolonly_frac 0.186 vs negatives 0.048
in the confirmed-healthy ranked cohort the feature separates NOTHING (2 pos vs 4 neg, inverted direction)
confound_that_kills_it.interpretation: predictable tail = truncation-shaped answers (already flagged by source!=ranked; arms B and D already respond to exactly this). Residual healthy-answer tail is target-mismatch (our estimated centroid vs the validator's GT draw), which is invisible from our own features BY CONSTRUCTION - every inference-time cosine is measured against our own target.

response_test.intervention: drop 4 lowest-cos tags of live-config answer, add 4 highest-cos unused live-pool candidates (dropped_by rank/insurance_displaced only); scored vs frozen judge, real formula + penalties, deterministic clean, no LLM screen (same both arms)
response_test.flag_rule_tested: answer mean cos < 0.63 OR depth60 < 20 (flags 61/120 - too loose; precision 0.25 y_low, FPR 0.54 on scored rows)
response_test.conclusion: the response makes flagged tasks WORSE - shifting slots toward higher own-target cosine optimizes the same possibly-wrong target; consistent with previously-rejected greedy composer (+0.004, loses 11/17) and max-unique (-0.024 final)

pipeline_hooks_for_the_record.note: computability was never the blocker - every feature hooks cleanly; information content is the blocker
pipeline_hooks_for_the_record.cos features (sel_*, depth, gap): sn33/pipeline.py stage 2 rank block (~line 1086) - ranked list with cos exists before compose()
pipeline_hooks_for_the_record.selection features: compose() line 726 returns the answer; features of it computable before _finish()
pipeline_hooks_for_the_record.source/truncation: Result.source (line 278) - ALREADY the better detector for the predictable tail

caveats: labels for the 41 unknown-source rows come from 24h-era live answers whose source is unrecorded (pre-PM2); Rule 3 forbids pooling them with the 6 confirmed-healthy - all cohorts reported separately
features of the live outcome-bearing answer (hist_*) computed by mapping historical tags into the replay candidate cos space (median coverage ~0.75)
intervention scored without the validator's non-deterministic LLM screen (identical treatment both arms)
frozen judge is one GT draw; per-task judge noise ~0.016 SE applies to per-row deltas, less to the paired mean
